shortDescription: Spring-return, load-return, and multistage hydraulic tensioners for controlled bolt preload.
longDescription: ToughTorq hydraulic bolt tensioners apply axial load directly to the stud for controlled preload on critical bolted joints. The range includes spring-return systems, load-return systems with modular adaptor kits, and compact multistage tensioners for high-capacity applications with restricted radial clearance.
features: Wide tooling coverage for multiple bolt and stud sizes
Custom configurations available for joint requirements

operatingRequirements.label: Hydraulic System
operatingRequirements.value: Use a compatible ultra-high-pressure pump, hose, couplers, gauge, and tensioner components rated for the selected system

operatingRequirements.label: Tensioner Selection
operatingRequirements.value: Match bolt diameter, thread pitch, required preload, stud projection, nut size, radial clearance, and working pressure

compatibility: Threaded adaptors, pullers, and bridges must match the bolt/stud specification and joint geometry.
Hydraulic components must share compatible pressure ratings and connection interfaces.
Multiple tensioners may be connected for simultaneous tensioning when the hydraulic system and application are configured accordingly.
sourceReference: 2026 ToughTorq catalog pages 38–40
